followup_reviews.Research finding: Rafah’s August 2021 passenger interruption is supported by OCHA and reported passage; retain inclusion and two directional phases. P1 is incoming stranded Palestinians from Egypt, P2 outgoing Gaza passengers. Salah Ad Din commercial goods and other crossings are outside these closures. Retain P1 23–26 August, three calendar days, and P2 23–29 August, six calendar days. Explicit AFP/OCHA dates take precedence over AA’s inconsistent relative incoming date. These are not lost scheduled operating-day counts. Keep Uncoded: the inspected reports give no official Egyptian rationale. Political-punishment context is not converted into an official reason. OCHA was freshly read; exact AFP and AA saved passages were reread. The AFP partial-reopening observation and prospective Sunday statement remain distinct; AA Sunday reporting does not erase its relative-date defect. Both phases remain unlocated. Their scoped interval rules cannot create coordinates or imply the whole Egypt–Gaza border or commercial gate was closed.
